scope: Tactic catalog item-adapter evidence: exact sources of land, water and facility columns

evidence.column_keys: CHeihouListDlg config resolves to property keys 1,4,8,48,49,16, matching tactic/system/power/land/water/facility
evidence.row_formatter: 0x570B35 calls the item vtable +0x24 formatter; 0x44748A emits the circle glyph when the vtable +0x18 property value is nonzero
evidence.water: Property 49 calls 0x446FA0, which derives the result from sequential tactic ID and system_code
evidence.facility: Property 16 directly reads San9KillerRecord +0x84 at 0x44726B, serialized hiho +0x20

conclusion: Only the facility column directly reads its dedicated hiho field. Land is always true, water is derived from tactic ID/system, and neither land nor water reads the Array compatibility mask. The facility field is a UI consumer input but remains non-authoritative for battle eligibility.
